title: Calibrated target-direction inference from complete memory-period functional-ultrasound response fields
counting_unit: One coherent neural-data assay. Native/program/tool modes, sessions, animals, temporal controls and transfer analyses are nested conditions; none is a separate benchmark.
scientific_question: Can a general LLM interpret a complete spatial vascular response field using fixed labeled calibration examples, and does an advance-written prediction program or case-adaptive analysis improve direction inference under identical query evidence?

measurement_and_claim.signal: Processed functional-ultrasound Power Doppler measurements of cerebral blood volume in left posterior parietal cortex. This is a vascular proxy for activity, not a direct electrical neural measurement.
measurement_and_claim.target: One of eight peripheral visual-target directions in a memory-guided saccade task, computed by the protected operator from source behavior.targetPos. Cue direction and the correct rewarded saccade direction coincide.
measurement_and_claim.what_success_would_establish: Predictive information about this experiment's target direction in the declared offline spatial response representation, with calibration and source-specific preprocessing.
not_established: Separating visual encoding, working memory, planned saccade and executed movement causally.
Online or causal real-time performance: supplied motion correction can depend on a whole session.
Pure neural causation independent of eye, vascular, motion or task-history covariates.
Human transfer or a population effect beyond two male macaques.
Raw-waveform or full-precision temporal understanding from a rendered response map.

full_population.authority: Complete Project Records/ProjectRecord_paper.json at commit a5571a3488b1d25e7259bccd8f3fe894b5e852bd, 12,552 bytes, SHA256 deb726b85aa3c8894cfebe0485ce22ceb99fa55f97c3a52a22f4e4cccabacc8d. The complete 49 public metadata rows are preserved below; they are declared acquisition metadata, not verified native arrays or candidate-visible identifiers.
full_population.scope: All49 listed session/run records and every corresponding published field-of-view, with all eligible trials. No example-session selection, top-voxel mask, significant-voxel filter, easy-direction filter or favorable timepoint search.
full_population.zero_record: S45/R1 has nTrials=0,nTargets=0 in source metadata. Preserve and reconcile against archive; it is not silently dropped. If authentic data contradict the metadata, stop and version the roster before any model result.
full_population.eligibility: Require a source-linked target vector, an authenticated per-trial memory interval and at least one complete Power Doppler acquisition wholly inside that interval and ending no later than go. Retain every resulting eligible trial irrespective of eventual success or decoder success. Offline released files may contain only successful trials; prototypeRT has an allTrials form. Distinguish source-conditioned availability from benchmark exclusion. An archive/behavior audit must resolve both forms before final case counts are frozen.
full_population.metadata_is_not_observation: 20622 is a sum of author-declared counts, not verified array extent or unique trial count. Run99 may represent author-concatenated runs; native identity/duplication must be checked. No observed biological arrays have been opened.
full_population.missingness: Publish the full acquisition/eligible/support/query/refusal census by record, including every trial with an absent, incomplete, early, late or unverifiable memory acquisition. Such a trial remains in the source census and holds its eligibility decision and the complete-cohort aggregate pending independent intake adjudication; it is not silently dropped to obtain a successful subset. Any absent or incompatible promised record also blocks the complete-cohort score. Freeze the complete eligibility and support/query denominators before inference. After freeze, missing inputs or outputs cannot remove a query from its denominator: a loader failure holds the affected run, and missing/invalid predictions retain the prescribed worst-case score. Any necessary change to frozen case membership requires a versioned intake amendment and renewed independent review before evaluation.

input_definition.endpoint: For each eligible trial use the last complete Power Doppler acquisition whose entire authenticated acquisition interval lies inside that trial's authenticated memory interval, with its end also no later than that trial's go cue. Both acquisition start and end must satisfy these bounds; merely ending before go is insufficient. Baseline remains the last complete acquisition ending before cue onset. All spatial pixels from the original field of view are retained.
input_definition.time_gate: Source getEpochs uses medians over successful trials and is insufficient for this endpoint. Actual per-trial cue, memory-state start/end and go times, together with each frame's acquisition start/end, must be authenticated in a common time base. No trial-median substitution, presumed timing, carry-forward of an earlier frame or substitution of a late/partial frame. If no complete acquisition lies wholly inside the verified memory interval, or any required timing is absent/unverifiable, hold eligibility and the complete-cohort aggregate under full_population.missingness; do not silently shrink the denominator. The dataset is held if these timings cannot be recovered.
input_definition.native_sampling: Preserve native1Hz or2Hz acquisition metadata. Select by actual acquisition intervals; do not blindly apply the source1:2:end downsampling. Final per-record frame ordinals are frozen before inference.
input_definition.response: At each valid pixel compute delta=(memory-baseline)/baseline using declared source floating arithmetic. Nonfinite values or baseline<=0 produce an explicit invalid-pixel mask. Preserve original operands privately. No label-dependent filtering or smoothing.

representation.name: Full-field response-map condition, deliberately distinct from full raw temporal decoding.
representation.training_scale: For each outer-session fold, scalar s is the maximum absolute finite delta over the other training sessions only, frozen before target-session processing. s=0 or nonfinite refuses the fold. This is a fixed operator transformation, not case-adaptive tuning.
representation.quantization: For valid pixels encode g=floor(127.5*(clip(delta/s,-1,1)+1)+0.5) in uint8. Store exactly one grayscale RGB pixel(g,g,g); invalid pixels are fixed magenta(255,0,255). Include s, native dimensions, spatial pitch and invalid/saturated counts. Valid unclipped reconstruction error is at most s/255. Saturation loses magnitude and is disclosed.
representation.complete_field: Never resize, crop, choose an ROI, average spatial pixels or remove invalid/saturated pixels. Any display enlargement is integer nearest-neighbor with the native image also supplied. The native image and metadata are byte-identical inputs to all three primary modes.
representation.limitations: This is a lossy visual representation. Native vision input processing can further resize or tokenize images. The model-specific image route must be tested and disclosed before native qualification; unsupported full-resolution delivery refuses that mode. Do not describe this as exact access to source floats.
representation.reference_check: Run competent references on identical rendered maps and on the private full-precision delta maps over the same cases, reporting degradation and uncertainty. Do not change quantization after seeing held-out model or baseline outcomes.

input_definition.context: Supply the same general method description, angle convention, allowed acquisition metadata, eight labeled reference maps and one query map to each mode. Source identifiers are replaced by opaque random keys. Provider/network lookup is unavailable during inference.

split_and_access.outer: Leave each of the48 positive source session/run records out in turn. Training-only prompt/program/tool construction can use other records; no target-session array or output is inspected during construction except the declared calibration packet. Reconcile the zero record and native roster first.
split_and_access.calibration: Within each held session select the earliest source-order eligible trial for each of the eight directions, using the private known labels. This creates exactly8 labeled reference maps if all eight are present. They are calibration observations and never scored as queries.
split_and_access.queries: Every other eligible trial in that held session is scored, including trials earlier than some calibration examples. Thus this is explicitly offline calibrated inference, not prospective chronological deployment. No test-trial subsampling is permitted. The declared-count arithmetic would give20238 query trials if all49 counts, eligibility and eight-per-positive-session assumptions were confirmed; this is only provisional.
split_and_access.construction_freezing: Prompt, program, exposed tools, versions, training-derived transformations and budgets freeze before the held-session calibration packet is delivered. Separate fresh authoring context/workspace for every outer fold and access mode; no reproduction, prior-fold assessment, test-label or evaluation artifact transfer.
split_and_access.per_query_isolation: Fresh inference context and process/workspace for each query. The identical8-map calibration packet may be repeated. No query-to-query history, shared writable memory, cached predictions, evolving prompt or feedback. For fixed-program mode, deterministic processing/fitting to those8 maps is allowed inside the frozen program; no other held-session cases become training data.
split_and_access.A: Frozen general-LLM native visual inference with the common9-map packet, no execution tools, no trained decoder outputs. All training-only prompt construction and model-pretraining exposures disclosed.
split_and_access.B: LLM writes and freezes a prediction program before held-session exposure. Program receives the same9-map byte packet per query and produces eight class probabilities; no model call at case time. Deterministic case-time fitting to the eight supplied calibration maps remains allowed. A program embedding outer-training fitted or pretrained predictor weights carries added learned information just as a callable trained model in C does; it is an augmented-program condition, excluded from the strict common-evidence A/B/C aggregate.
split_and_access.C: Fresh general-LLM case-adaptive reasoning and Python over exactly the same9-map byte packet. Any callable trained model must be trained solely on the permitted outer training data, frozen, and declared as added learned information; results with such a model are separately labeled augmented-tool results rather than silently pooled with the strict common-evidence A/B/C comparison. This rule applies identically to B's embedded fitted/pretrained predictor weights: storage inside a program does not erase their additional training information.
split_and_access.fairness: A/B/C share the same training-only construction allocation, private split, calibration and rendered query information. Construction artifacts differ by mode and are recorded. For B and C alike, record every embedded/callable learned predictor, its weights/version, training provenance, exposure and supplied outputs; additional fitted/pretrained predictor weights imply an explicitly augmented condition, not strict common-evidence inference. This clarification does not authorize external pretrained predictors or previously forbidden data: C's permitted-outer-training-only restriction and the same exposure restriction for augmented B remain in force. The base general LLM's own pretraining remains separately disclosed as in A and pretraining_contamination. Full-precision or full-temporal inputs are a separate information condition, not an unfair native-versus-tool comparison.
split_and_access.pretraining_contamination: Public release may be memorized. Random opaque IDs and fresh contexts prevent simple lookup and state leakage, not pretraining exposure. Report model cutoff/training disclosure where available and call this public-development evaluation until protected new data exist.

outputs_and_scoring.output: One opaque query_id and eight finite nonnegative probabilities summing to1 within frozen tolerance1e-6. Fixed class ordering is0,45,...315 degrees with source targetPos x-right/y-up verified. Argmax ties choose the lowest canonical angle.
outputs_and_scoring.primary: Per-session balanced accuracy: mean recall over all eight true directions among non-calibration queries. Average sessions equally within each animal, then average the two animal means equally. Every eligible query belongs to the denominator.
outputs_and_scoring.invalid: Duplicate, extra, missing or malformed ID/probability output is retained and scored incorrect; no abstention can improve the denominator. A fold with a source class absent after calibration has an undefined balanced-accuracy estimand and blocks the complete primary aggregate rather than renormalizing over fewer classes.
secondary: Complete8x8 confusion matrices and ordinary accuracy by animal/session/acquisition system.
Mean absolute wrapped angular error min(|pred-true|,360-|pred-true|), with missing/invalid predictions assigned180degrees.
Multiclass Brier score with malformed/missing output charged the maximum2, and calibration/reliability plots.
Paired deltas versus fixed baselines and each primary access mode, same cases and grouped aggregation.
Performance by elapsed inter-session time and1Hz/2Hz recording route, descriptive and prespecified.
outputs_and_scoring.uncertainty: Only two biological animals. Report both animal results. Session-cluster paired bootstrap intervals are conditional on these animals and must retain the fixed per-animal weighting; they are not animal-population confidence intervals. Trials, voxels and repeated fold predictions are not independent biological replicates. Do not use trialwise binomial precision to imply a large animal cohort.
outputs_and_scoring.scientific_admission: Scorer correctness, no-leakage controls, competent reference, rendered-versus-float loss, full coverage and independent replication precede qualification. No expected score or SOTA threshold is invented from the original paper's selected sessions.

mandatory: Uniform eight-way predictor and support-only class prior on identical cases.

Nearest calibrated response-map template using the exact eight support maps: full-field masked cosine and squared-distance references, selected on outer training sessions only. No functionally chosen voxels.

Eight-shot regularized kernel ridge on the flattened common rendered pixels and explicit invalid-mask channels. Fit only to the exact eight supplied support maps; strictly positive ridge selected from{0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100} using identically constructed episodes from outer training sessions. Define scaling, intercept and singular/empty-mask behavior in implementation before evaluation. Dimension can vary across sessions because each fit is within one common support/query geometry.

Source-informed PCA95%-variance plus two-axis LDA under the original larger training sets is a separate full-information reference, not a competent matched eight-shot default. It needs its own complete fixed evaluation split/source and runtime review. Do not claim that default LDA trained on eight high-dimensional examples is a qualified baseline.
Pre-cue response-map control with the same spatial dimensions, support and scoring; reveals history/anatomical/task-prior shortcuts.
Whole-query spatial-block permutation and between-query neural reassignment controls, retaining each corresponding label and all sample counts. Only protected evaluator generates these controls.
Pixel-coordinate or acquisition-metadata-only predictor, and eye/motion nuisance predictors if authenticated signals exist; nuisance availability must not be manufactured.
source_cautions: The paper's pairwise source z-scores the complete test session independently. That transductive normalization differs from this training-only transformation.
Whole-session motion correction/angiogram alignment can use later data. Existing processed-input scope is explicitly offline and cannot support a strict online assertion.
Official main figures use selected-session and time-resolved analyses. Some source summaries maximize across timepoints. This task fixes a per-trial memory endpoint and never picks best test time.

Helper train_test_multicoder contains suspicious normalization/vertical-label expressions, but the inspected main pairwise route calls classifyDoppler directly. No executed defect or impact on published results is asserted.

Within-session cross-validation mutates standardized data across fold iterations in the source. Its numerical implications require separate controls; do not silently call a clean implementation exact author reproduction.
GPL code and third-party MATLAB toolbox licenses must be respected. An available GitHub repository does not establish installed MATLAB availability or transitive numerical parity.

Source concatenateRuns may load a raw/unregistered file when its registered file is missing, then calls correctMotion when registered=true. That fallback is not necessarily an unregistered final concatenation; the explicit registered=false multi-session route separately warns about missing alignment. The prospective benchmark loader must still refuse unreviewed fallback, automatic cropping or altered preprocessing. This is source-route interpretation, not an executed numerical result or a demonstrated published-analysis defect.
baselines_and_controls.same_plane_transfer: A prespecified secondary zero-target-calibration test uses all source-session/test-session combinations within each animal and same physical imaging plane after independently justified alignment. Metadata suggests47 positive records in repeated slot groups; P-cor5/S106 singleton has no matching same-slot training session and remains in primary calibration testing. Slot labels and fractional ap_plane differences require a physical-plane join before transfer. No same-slot equality is assumed to prove identical plane. This secondary does not narrow the primary or add a benchmark.
